description: Data-Substrate Expansion (tasks/prd-data-substrate-expansion.md, PRD US-061..US-075): data menu + directive pre-flight, energy/macro $mkt_* broadcast fields, per-ticker news counts — every new series must exist in all four places (bin store, factor-source folder, daily refresh, snapshot manifest) and pass the exact-weights refresh-parity harness. userStories.title: Data menu module + generated reference doc
userStories.description: As the orchestrator, I want a machine-readable inventory of what the store can express so prompts and pre-flight checks share one source of truth. [PRD US-061]
acceptanceCriteria: New module data/menu.py introspects the Qlib store (fields, date range, universes) and merges a curated descriptions table (semantics, PIT caveats, market-level vs per-ticker flag)
python -m data.menu prints the human menu; python -m data.menu --json emits machine-readable output with a stable schema (field name, kind, description, pit_note)

docs/reference/data-menu.md is regenerated by the module (python -m data.menu --write-doc); a pytest fails when the checked-in doc drifts from the module's output against the real store schema (hermetic: test builds a tiny fixture store or mocks the introspection)
Curated table covers the current OHLCV+factor fields today; unknown store fields appear in the menu with an 'undocumented' marker rather than being dropped
make check passes (ruff + pyright + pytest)
userStories.notes: data/menu.py + tests/test_menu.py + docs/reference/data-menu.md. Doc is schema-only (no volatile store facts) so the drift test is hermetic AND the checked-in doc survives daily refreshes.

userStories.title: Inject the data menu into the directive-crafting prompt

acceptanceCriteria: orchestrator/prompts.py directive-crafting prompt includes the rendered menu text sourced from data/menu.py (single source of truth — no hand-copied field list)
Menu load is best-effort: store unreadable at prompt-build time degrades to an explicit 'menu unavailable' line, never an exception into the Slack handler
Test asserts the crafted-directive prompt contains menu field names from a fixture store, and the degraded path produces the fallback line
make check passes (ruff + pyright + pytest)
userStories.notes: prompts.data_menu_context (best-effort, MENU_UNAVAILABLE_LINE fallback) + ConversationCore menu_builder= param (digest_builder pattern); app.py wires it. Live menu ~1.7k chars.

userStories.title: Directive pre-flight: data_required verified against the menu
userStories.description: As the operator, I want directives that need missing data refused before launch so no GPU run is spent discovering a data gap (run #36 burned its budget exactly this way). [PRD US-062]
acceptanceCriteria: The crafted directive's structured output gains a data_required list of store fields/series the hypothesis relies on; the saved-directive Slack restatement renders it as a 'Data required: ...' line
The orchestrator verifies each data_required entry programmatically against data/menu.py (string match against real fields — never an LLM claim)

All present: restatement line ends '— all present in store' and the directive is startable; any missing: directive is saved but NOT startable, thread reply says 'parked — needs ingestion: <series>' naming each missing series
Attempting to start a parked directive is refused with the same parked message (state enforced, not just message text)
Tests cover both paths (all-present, missing-series) plus the start-refusal of a parked directive
make check passes (ruff + pyright + pytest)

userStories.title: Market-series probe script (formalize the 2026-08-24 findings)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the FMP market-series probe scripted and its outcome recorded so the symbol set and the treasury window cap are pinned by a repeatable check, not a one-off. [PRD US-064]
acceptanceCriteria: ops/probe_market_series.sh (run via onecli run --agent rdq-research) fetches EOD history over the store window (2025-01-02 -> yesterday) for BZUSD, CLUSD, HOUSD, NGUSD, RBUSD, GCUSD, DXUSD via /stable/historical-price-eod/light, and the treasury curve via /stable/treasury-rates chunked <=90 days per request
Per series the script prints symbol, row count, first/last date, coverage vs NYSE trading days; any non-200 or empty response is a printed FAILURE and nonzero exit, never silently skipped
Script asserts the treasury cap is handled: it demonstrates a single full-window request returns fewer rows than the chunked fetch (proving chunking is required and working)
Probe outcome (symbols, endpoints, coverage, the ~90-day treasury cap) recorded in docs/decisions.md dated entry
Live run through OneCLI succeeds on-box and its output is captured in the progress log
make check passes (ruff + pyright + pytest)

userStories.title: FMP client methods for commodity EOD and treasury rates
userStories.description: As a developer, I want typed client support so market-series ingestion reuses the existing retry/error machinery. [PRD US-065]
acceptanceCriteria: data/fmp.py gains get_commodity_eod(symbol, start, end) and get_treasury_rates(start, end) with the same retry/backoff/typed-error behavior as get_eod_bars, returning typed rows (date, price/curve values)

get_treasury_rates transparently chunks to <=90 calendar days per request and merges, deduplicating boundary dates; a unit test covers a >90-day window and asserts multiple underlying requests plus a contiguous merged result
Unit tests use recorded fixtures — no live HTTP in pytest

userStories.title: Market series in the bin store as raw broadcast fields
userStories.description: As the factor loop and the verified store-recompute refresh path, I want market series readable as $mkt_* fields on every instrument row. [PRD US-066]
acceptanceCriteria: data/build_store.py writes $mkt_brent, $mkt_wti, $mkt_heatoil, $mkt_natgas, $mkt_gasoline, $mkt_gold, $mkt_dxy, $mkt_y10 (treasury year10) as per-instrument fields, identical value across instruments per date

Tests build a tiny fixture store end-to-end and read $mkt_* values back per instrument/date

userStories.title: Daily refresh appends market fields
userStories.description: As the promoted strategy, I need yesterday's market values present before the 04:30 ET refresh so factors using them re-predict correctly every day. [PRD US-067]
acceptanceCriteria: data/refresh.py pulls each market series since its own last stored date and carries the $mkt_* fields through the temp -> validate -> atomic-swap rebuild (fields taught to skip the raw-recovery/adjustment math: implicit factor 1)
Same '--end is yesterday America/New_York, never today' rule as equity bars
Idempotency preserved: nothing new anywhere -> store byte-for-byte untouched, exit 0 'already current' (existing behavior test extended to cover market fields)

A refresh where one market series fetch fails (simulated FMP outage) forward-fills that series, posts a Slack warning line, and exits 0 — it must never block the rebalance chain; test covers this path with a mocked failure
make check passes (ruff + pyright + pytest)

userStories.title: News backfill job: per-ticker daily counts, PIT cutoff, checkpointed
userStories.description: As the factor loop, I want a daily news-attention series per ticker whose values were knowable at each day's close. [PRD US-072]

Checkpointed per ticker (build_store.py pattern): crash mid-list resumes on rerun without refetching or duplicating; checkpoint reused only when its (start, end) window matches

Raw article records (ts, headline, url, publisher) archived to disk keyed by ticker/date so sentiment scoring later never refetches
Unit tests with recorded fixtures for cutoff bucketing (incl. a 16:00:00 boundary case and a DST-transition date), checkpoint resume, and 0-fill; no live HTTP in pytest
Live smoke: 5-ticker, 1-month backfill through OneCLI runs clean on-box, spot-checked against a known high-news date (e.g. MRNA 2026-08-19 count spike), output in the progress log
make check passes (ruff + pyright + pytest)
